title: Air Force funding of the movie Stargate

tellings.quote: You know, that the Air Force funded that movie Stargate, you know, the Kurt Russell
Do you know the the Air Force funded the movie Stargate where there's like a portal by the pyramid?
tellings.difference: Mentions the portal by the pyramid in the movie.
tellings.link_reason: Jesse Michels again says the Air Force funded the movie Stargate.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, has said on his show more than once that the US Air Force helped pay for Stargate, a 1994 film starring Kurt Russell. In one telling he notes that the film is about a portal found by a pyramid. He raises it as a sign that the military may have a hand in shaping how the public imagines such ideas.
